The '''Hangar 01''' was one of the hangars of the [[Jiguuna Spaceport]], located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:TLF" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vexx]] was killed in Hangar 01 by a  [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]].<ref name="TOR:TLF" />
